encyclopedia.summary: Ron Clements and John Musker's 1992 Disney feature turns the Arabian Nights lamp story into a musical comedy. A street boy uses a genie to pass as a prince and ends up recovering his own voice. Robin Williams's improvised performance as the Genie reset what animation voice work could do.
highlights: The Genie's lines and songs grew beyond the script while the film was being made.
A fantasy about borrowed identity comes back around to the question of who he is.
It shaped the comedy-sidekick formula of Disney features after it.

encyclopedia.summary: Disney's first feature-length animation. A princess poisoned by her stepmother is brought back by seven dwarfs and the animals of the forest, and the film set the grammar every later Disney feature followed. It opened in 1937, directed by David Hand and others.

key_facts.value: The Brothers Grimm fairy tale Snow White

highlights: An early technical landmark, using the multiplane camera to build depth.
Each of the seven dwarfs got a name and a temperament, inventing the character-merchandise playbook.
Songs and a princess story became the template for Disney features after it.
